name: Onfleet
summary: Last-mile delivery management platform with a documented Route Optimization API: a caller schedules an optimization over tasks and teams, starts the engine, polls status and applies the result. Its cost model is public and per-parameter, including a per-vehicle dispatch cost and a penalty for delivering past a task's time window. No job is claimed: the only job it fits carries a comparative clause no seller can phrase, which is the subject of a separate pull request. The optimization endpoints are Enterprise-plan only.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-14, no credentials: GET onfleet.com/api/v2/organization 401 InvalidCredentials, no www-authenticate; the API key is the Basic-auth username. mcp.onfleet.com/mcp answers 401 with resource_metadata, full OAuth discovery and a registration endpoint, and is in no vendor doc.
